sections.title: JAGGAER INDIRECT SOLUTION CONSULTANT BULLETI N
paragraphs: Subject : Purchase Order Workflow Topics : Invalid Distribution Step
Revise PO Step

Invalid Distribution Step DESCRIPTION All PO workflow that includes a distribution step should also include an " Invalid Distribution " step, to ensure the Suppliers distribution set -up is valid for the PO. WHERE SHOULD THIS STEP GO? In PO Workflow before the Revision and Distribution steps. WHAT DO I TELL THE CLIENT ABOUT THIS STEP? Tell them it indicates a Supplier mis -configuration (the PO is supposed to distribute but cannot).
• Approvers in this step will see a Warning at the top of the PO document.
• Approvers should correct the related Suppliers Fulfillment Center Distribution method (or have it corrected by a User with permissions).
• Once Corrected, the Warning will no longer be displayed on the PO and there will be a distribution method indicated:
They can now “approve” the PO out of the “Invalid Distribution” step.
WHAT ELSE SHOULD I KNOW? This step is only effective if you have NOT defaulted " Manual " as a distribution for all Suppliers .
Defaulting Manual inherits to all Suppliers and is a valid distribution method.
If all POs are supposed to go out either Email, Fax or cXML based on the Suppliers Fulfillment Center, don’t default a distribution method here
BULLETIN #: JISC000 2 UPDATED: 02/04/2020

sections.title: STEPS TO IMPLEMENT
paragraphs: STEPS TO IMPLEMENT
1. Add new “Invalid Distribution” step to PO Workflow before the Revision and Distribution steps:
2. Ensure the static Workflow Activity has the proper criteria:

<Activity name="Invalid Distribution"> <ActivityType>manual</ActivityType> <StepRef name="Invalid Distribution" /> <Rule><![CDATA[Document.HasInvalidDistribution() == true && Document.CanDistributeRevision == true && Document.Requires RuleGroupEvaluation("Invalid Distribution") == true]]></Rule> <FolderSelectionRule>MultiElementDynamic</FolderSelectionRule> <Attribute name="RuleGroupInternalName"> <AttrValue lang="default">Invalid Distribution</AttrValue> </Attribute> </Activity>
This criteria Element is key: Document.HasInvalidDistribution() == true (Determines that the distribution method has issues)

• Additional criteria can also be added; o Document.CanDistributeRevision == true (Returns true if the PO has been flagged to distribute) o Document.IsNotValid() == true (Typically used for PO Imports, returns true if the imported PO has issues pertaining to the Supplier configuration) o Document.RequiresRuleGroupEvaluation("Exclude from Distribution") == fal se (If you are using an ADW Rule Group to determine POs that should NOT distribute )

3. Route the approval to an ADW Rule Group which includes a Rule that will evaluate “true” (the criteria has already been satisfied in static workflow, so the Rule for routing just need s to be “true” (see below). If needed, you could have Rules that route by Business Unit, Department , etc.

Remember: In order to modify a Supplier’s Fulfillment Center the “approver” has to have the “ Manage Supplier Profiles ” permission. If they don’t a process has to be in place (perhaps using the PO Comments) for the approver to notify a User that can update the Supp lier Profile / Fulfillment Center.

sections.title: Revise PO Step
paragraphs: DESCRIPTION The Revise PO step creates the PO documents to be distributed to the Supplier and/or the XML to be exported. WHERE SHOULD THIS STEP GO? In PO Workflow before the Distribution step . WHAT ELSE SHOULD I KNOW? The Revi se PO step can have many different names ; “Revise PO”, “Create Supplier Documents” , “Create PO Revision”, etc. but regardless of what it is called , it’s always an automated step that uses the CreatePORevisionRobot .
Typically w hen the PO document initially hits this step, the first, original set o f documents is created :
The Revi se PO step is not the only step (or way) that a PO Revision can be created:
• If a Revision doesn ’t already exist, a PO Export will automatically create one (A)
• An update to the Document via an integration will create an Revision (B)
• The Revise PO Step/Robo t that we are discussing will create a revision (C)
• The Revise PO action from within the U/I will also create a Revision.
Even in this example , where an export has already created the revision, YOU SHOULD ALWAYS HAVE a Revise PO step immediately before the PO Distribution.

sections.title: STEPS TO IMPLEMENT
paragraphs: STEPS TO IMPLEMENT
1. Ensure you have loaded the PO Workflow Folder that uses the CreatePORevisionRobot
2. Add new “ Revise PO ” step to PO Workflow before the Distribution step :
3. Add the static Workflow Activity , using the “Folder ” that was loaded for the Robot :

<Activity name="RevisePO"> <ActivityTy pe>automated</ActivityType> <StepRef name="RevisePO" /> <FolderRef name="Revise PO" /> <Rule><![CDATA[true]]></Rule> <FolderSelectionRule>ExplicitFolder</FolderSelectionRule> </Activity>
A majority of the time the only criteria need for this activity is “true ”, it is rare to have any other criteria associated.
